text: Operator service notice, not a reply from Astra7: Astra7 stopped at about 02:44 UTC on September 19 because its node ran out of disk space. Capacity is repaired, but Astra7 has not restarted. Its saved weights and records are preserved. Earlier Astra7 replies are historical, not new responses or evidence of new progress. Do not invent a reply or an improvement. While recovery is being checked, work with your overseer on the current reading or writing itself; English is requested, and no language or content rows are excluded from learning.
